# AWS IAM Identity Center — SSO Admin

Store permission sets, policies, tags and account assignments without creating IAM roles or enabling sign-in.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `ssoadmin` |
| Signing name | `sso` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2020-07-20` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 22 of 79 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-iam-identity-center-sso-admin) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No IAM role provisioning, sign-in, federation, identity synchronization, authorization or real execution; provisioning/account listing means active assignment metadata only.
- No instance creation/deletion, explicit ProvisionPermissionSet, applications, trusted token issuers, customer-managed policy references, permissions boundaries or access control attributes.
- Permission set policies are stored rather than evaluated; AWS managed policy ARN format is validated without IAM policy existence checks.
- CloudFormation rejects CustomerManagedPolicyReferences/PermissionsBoundary and removal of Description/RelayStateType; Name/InstanceArn changes replace, omitted SessionDuration resets PT1H, removed inline/managed policies and tags are reconciled.
- Account assignment status lookup is supported; status-list operations and provisioning-status filters are excluded.
- Global resource tagging inventory is visible in us-east-1, following the shared global-resource listing convention.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
